workouts.name: BARBELL BENCH PRESS
workouts.description: A compound press that builds chest thickness, triceps, and pressing power from a stable bench.
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with your eyes directly under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar toward the middle of your chest with control.
Press the bar upward until your arms are extended.

workouts.name: INCLINE DUMBBELL PRESS
workouts.description: An upper-chest focused pressing movement using dumbbells.
instructions: Set the bench to a moderate incline.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press both dumbbells upward.
Lower them slowly back to the starting position.

workouts.name: BARBELL BACK SQUAT
workouts.description: A foundational lower-body movement that develops the quads and glutes.
instructions: Position the bar across your upper back.
Stand with your feet around shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees and hips while keeping your chest controlled.
Drive through your feet to return to standing.

workouts.name: ROMANIAN DEADLIFT
workouts.description: A hip-hinge movement targeting the hamstrings, glutes, and posterior chain.
instructions: Hold the barbell in front of your thighs.
Push your hips backward while keeping your back neutral.
Lower the bar along your legs.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

workouts.name: PULL-UPS
workouts.description: A bodyweight pulling exercise that develops the lats and biceps.
instructions: Grip the pull-up bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower yourself under control.

workouts.name: SEATED CABLE ROW
workouts.description: A horizontal pulling movement for building the middle and upper back.
instructions: Sit upright with your feet supported.
Grip the cable handle with both hands.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs.
Slowly extend your arms.

workouts.name: SEATED DUMBBELL SHOULDER PRESS
workouts.description: A seated overhead pressing exercise that develops the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit upright with a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with the dumbbells near shoulder height.
Press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower them slowly.

workouts.name: BARBELL BICEP CURL
workouts.description: A classic isolation exercise for developing the biceps.
instructions: Stand upright holding the barbell.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly.

workouts.name: CABLE TRICEP PUSHDOWN
workouts.description: A cable isolation movement designed to strengthen the triceps.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine.
Grip the rope with both hands.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Push the rope downward and slowly return.

workouts.name: WALKING LUNGES
workouts.description: A dynamic unilateral leg exercise that targets the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent.
Push through the front foot and step forward.

workouts.name: RUSSIAN TWIST
workouts.description: A rotational core exercise that challenges the abdominals and obliques.
instructions: Sit with your knees bent.
Lean your torso back while keeping your core engaged.
Hold the medicine ball in front of you.
Rotate your torso from side to side.

workouts.name: FOREARM PLANK
workouts.description: An isometric exercise that strengthens the core and improves trunk stability.
instructions: Place your forearms on the mat.
Extend your legs behind you.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and hold.
